items.title: H.A.P
items.decryption: Remember Harsha's religious tilt: He was initially a devotee of Shiva/Sun, then shifted to Buddhism under Hiuen-Tsang (Xuanzang).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Mistaking Harsha as a 'Buddhist from birth'. He transitioned late in his reign.
Confusing the Prayag Assembly (charity) with the Kannauj Assembly (theological debate).
Assuming Harsha enforced Buddhism as a state religion; he remained religiously tolerant.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in Kannauj
  • Control over Gangetic plains
  • Influence extended to Malwa/Orissa

Personalities

  • Harshavardhana
  • Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang)
  • Divakaramitra

Mindmap: Harsha and Buddhism

  • Religious Evolution
    • Early phase: Worshipper of Shiva and Surya
    • Later phase: Deep leaning toward Mahayana Buddhism
    • Influencers: Sister Rajyashri and Monk Xuanzang
  • Institutional Support
    • Kannauj Assembly: Mahayana exposition
    • Prayag Assembly: Quintennial 'Moksha Parishad'
    • Monastery building: Construction at Nalanda
AssemblyPurposeSignificance
KannaujTheological DebatePopularized Mahayana tenets
PrayagGrand Charity'Dana' to Brahmins, Buddhists, and poor
